results.note: Official Louvre page lists €22 for EEA residents/citizens and €32 for non-EEA visitors. Cheapest standard adult ticket reported (€22).

Visit Paris Region (regional tourism board) lists plein tarif €12.50 for a timed ticket, or €11 when bought on site. Cheapest option reported (€11 on-site). The museum's own site returned 403, so the price comes from this page.
Official City of Paris page says access is free ("accès libre et gratuit").

BnF has no single admission fee. The cheapest paid standard adult option is a 1-day public library reading ticket at €5 (plein tarif), while the Richelieu museum and temporary exhibitions are €15 plein tarif. Prices apply from 1 Sept 2026. Amount reported is €15 for the museum visit. Correction: the cheapest adult ticket is the €5 library day ticket, so €5 is the stated lowest price.
